log.title: Builders, farmers and guards for every race
log.detail: Three new roles. Builders survey the base around their post and rebuild anything enemies or explosions destroy, using blocks from a nearby chest. Farmers harvest ripe crops, replant, till near water and store the harvest in a chest. Guards hold a post, patrol it and call nearby troops when attacked. Each race gets its own names and gear for them; demon workers are imps.

log.title: Demon player: hand and foot claws removed
log.detail: Bare hands and feet. The forearm brambles, thorns and wing hooks stay.

log.title: Fluid wing animation
log.detail: Phase-driven wingbeat with a fast downstroke and slow recovery, wingtip follow-through, effort that tracks takeoff, climbs and dives, staggered unfolding, and frame-rate-independent easing. The cloak rides the beat a moment late.

log.title: Wings fold at the elbow
log.detail: Tucked flat down the back on the ground, half-open in a jump, fully spread in flight.

log.title: Demon wing flight
log.detail: Demon players take off like an elytra (jump while falling) without wearing one, with a gentle constant thrust toward where they look and a hunger cost.

log.title: Demon player head rebuilt from the Oryx reference
log.detail: Spiked cowl blades that flare over the shoulders, a sharpened V jaw, a flat mouthless face and a band of violet eyes.

log.title: Demon player model
log.detail: Player-sized demon skin with wings, robe, cloak and brambles, drawn over any player of the demon race and seen by everyone on the server.

log.title: Imp roles with their own look
log.detail: Imp, Imp Bulwark (scrap armor), Imp Impaler (studded harness, bone spikes) and Imp Firecaster (rune mantle, ember orb, fire bolts). Gear is textured, with a glow layer.

log.title: Imps: demon foot soldiers
log.detail: A custom winged, scorpion-tailed model at 0.7× size for low-rank demon troops.

log.title: Champions, race unit names and race weapons
log.detail: Every race fields its own named unit for each role, plus a Champion with a signature ability.

log.title: Mana, three new races, five new factions, waves and breaching
log.detail: Mana ore and the Manabloom crop pay for summons. Demons, angels and the hive join the races. Wave campaigns run with a boss bar, and raiders hack through walls.

log.title: Warfront mod and Age of Banners modpack
log.detail: Races, factions, formations, morale, archer volleys, healers, tower defense, plus a curated magic and adventure pack.

log.title: Size and silhouette for every race
log.detail: Unique models per race and role, with some units larger or smaller than others, from upcoming reference images.

tests.demonsAreImmuneToFire: Fire spares demons and hurts humans
